commands.name: clipboard send
commands.summary: Start sending what the Windows clipboard holds to the server of every exchange account this PC is signed in to, or the one file in --file / the text in --text instead of the clipboard's content (exactly one of the two, never both).

args.name: file
args.description: One existing file to send instead of the clipboard's content: it travels to the other devices as a file value, exactly as one copied file on the clipboard would. A file over the transfer limit (5368709120 bytes) is exit 10; the path is never echoed back.

args.name: text
args.description: A given text to send instead of the clipboard's content. Bounded by the command line's 32 KiB argument limit.

args.name: json
args.description: Print the response line itself.

args.name: result
args.description: Where to write the response data as JSON.

returns.name: kind
returns.description: with --file or --text: what was handed to the transfer - file or text

returns.name: sizeBytes
returns.description: with --file or --text: the source's size in bytes, known at hand-off

exitCodes.meaning: accepted: the transfer has started; CyrFlip shows how it ended in the notification area
the file in --file could not be checked (a local path that does not answer)
the running copy is older and takes no commands, or it did not answer in time
both --file and --text, a value an option does not take, or a file over the transfer limit (5368709120 bytes) - the limit is named, the path is not
the exchange clipboard module is off, the file in --file does not exist, or busy: another transfer or a dialog is open
other programs may not ask for this - the setting is off - or the running copy runs as administrator
a network share in --file did not answer in time

examples.expect: 0 once the transfer has started

examples.line: start /wait CyrFlip.exe clipboard send --file C:\\temp\\report.pdf --result C:\\temp\\answer.json
examples.expect: exit 0 once the transfer has started; the answer's data holds kind file and sizeBytes

commands.name: screenshot region
commands.summary: Let the person choose a part of the screen - the selection appears over whatever they are doing, and Escape cancels it - and save it as a PNG file. args.description: A file name ending in .png, an existing folder, or a path ending in a backslash; used exactly as given, and a relative path is taken from the caller's working directory. A folder, or a path ending in a backslash, makes CyrFlip name the file screenshot_yyMMdd_HHmmss.png from the moment of the capture (with (2), (3).. when that name is taken). The folder is never created.

args.name: overwrite

It needs the draw-on-capture module on, and answers module-off (11) when it is off.

args.name: clipboard

args.description: Print the response line itself.

args.description: Where to write the response data as JSON.
